data.content:
Predicted lineups: Real Madrid are projected in a 4-2-3-1 with Yan Diomande on the left in place of the suspended Vinicius Junior, Arda Guler on the right and Jude Bellingham between them. Dean Huijsen and Ibrahima Konate are projected as the central pair, with Antonio Rudiger, who started the last two games, the alternative. Sevilla are projected in a 4-2-3-1 with the back four and pivot that started at Levante, Chidera Ejuke in for the injured Sierra and Ure alone up front. [...] Vinicius Junior's suspension changes Madrid's left side, but Yan Diomande and Marc Cucurella still give them a clear route against a Sevilla right flank weakened by Miguel Sierra's injury.
